summary_en: HYBE JAPAN will launch a public tender offer for KeyHolder shares at ¥1,200 per share and warrants at ¥1 per warrant from November 19, 2026 to January 6, 2027. The board expressed support for the offer while deferring the decision to shareholders. The listing on Tokyo Stock Exchange Standard Market will be maintained after the transaction.
title_en: Notice of Opinion Regarding Public Tender Offer for Company Shares by HYBE JAPAN Co., Ltd.
translation_en_brief:
HYBE JAPAN Co., Ltd., a wholly owned subsidiary of HYBE Co., Ltd. (listed on Korea Exchange; code 352820), announced a public tender offer for KeyHolder, Inc. The bidder will acquire common shares at ¥1,200 per share and warrants (second series, with exercise period from July 24, 2018 to July 23, 2028) at ¥1 per warrant. The tender offer period is set for 30 business days from November 19, 2026 to January 6, 2027. The stated purpose is to make the company a consolidated subsidiary.

KeyHolder's board of directors held on November 18, 2026 adopted a resolution expressing support for the offer. The board determined that shareholders and warrant holders should decide independently whether to tender their securities. Notably, the tender offer is not intended to result in delisting from the Tokyo Stock Exchange Standard Market; KeyHolder's listing is expected to be maintained following the transaction.

There are no existing capital, personnel, transaction, or related-party relationships between KeyHolder and HYBE JAPAN. The company issued multiple series of warrants to key individuals and employees; only the second series warrants (160,294 units representing 1,602,940 shares) are subject to this tender offer, while subsequent warrant series issued to employees remain outside the offer scope.
